Her sisters, on their big horses, thought it was exciting to cross the river at the deepest part. They never seemed to notice that Joni’s little pony sank a bit deeper. 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말을 주어진 단어를 올바른 순서로 배열하여 완성하시오. (영어로, 12단어)
[단어] around / at / her / legs / of / pony / rushing / staring / swirling / the / the / waters

det.korean: 소용돌이치는 강물이 조랑말 다리 주위로 세차게 흐르는 것을 응시하며
det.analysis: staring at + 목적어(the swirling waters) + 현재분사구(rushing around the legs of her pony)
det.tip: 분사구문 staring + waters 수식 rushing 분사구

questions.wa: staring at the swirling waters rushing around the legs of her pony
accept: staring at the swirling waters rushing around the legs of her pony

다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말을 조건에 맞게 영어로 쓰시오.
